showtime.cancelHint: Every ticket sold is voided and the money is refunded through the gateway. This cannot be undone.
showtime.deleteConfirm: Delete this showtime? One with bookings cannot be deleted.

showtime.startAtHint: Cinema local time. The end time is derived from the movie's runtime.

booking.noPayment: This order carries no payment. Counter sales are cash, and an order still on hold has not paid yet.
booking.paymentFilterHint: The payment filter only matches orders that already carry money. An order on hold with an open checkout will not appear.
booking.reason_showtime_cancelled: the cinema cancelled this showtime; refunded automatically

hall.activeHint: When off, the hall takes no new showtimes. The backend refuses to turn it off while the hall still has an open upcoming showtime.
hall.addRowHint: Add one row of {{count}} standard seats to the end of the grid
hall.aislesHint: Comma-separated column numbers. Display only — it changes nothing about capacity or pricing. Leave empty for no aisles.
hall.copyPricesHint: Without it the new hall has no prices at all, and none of its showtimes will be visible to customers until all four seat types are priced.
hall.deleteConfirm: Delete this hall? It cannot be deleted while it still has a showtime that has not finished.
hall.deleteRowConfirmBody: Deletes the hall's last row. Only refused if a seat in this row has ever been part of a booking.
hall.discardBody: Every change made since entering Edit mode will be lost and cannot be recovered.
hall.editScopeNote: Editing here never touches seats. To change the seat grid, open the seat map.
hall.fillGapHint: Click to add a seat here
hall.gridMismatch: The hall record declares a {{declaredRows}} × {{declaredCols}} grid, but the real seat data is {{actualRows}} × {{actualCols}}. The map below follows the seats. Nothing in the database forces the two to agree, so regenerate the layout to bring them back in line.
hall.gridSummary: {{cells}} grid cells · {{seats}} seats · {{sellable}} sellable · {{gaps}} gaps · {{doubles}} double-width
hall.mergeCoupleConfirmBody: Merges the 2 selected seats into 1 couple seat. The right seat is deleted entirely. Only refused if either seat has ever been part of a booking.
hall.mergeCoupleNotAdjacent: The 2 seats must be adjacent in the same row
hall.name: Hall name
hall.noSeats: This hall has no seats yet
hall.pricesIncompleteBody: No price for: {{types}}. All four are needed before this hall's showtimes appear to customers.
hall.pricesIncompleteTooltip: The customer showtime list only keeps halls with all four seat types priced. This hall still shows here, but customers see none of its showtimes.
hall.pricesRequiredHint: The backend requires all four seat types at creation time, each greater than zero.
hall.regenerateScopeNote: This form only sets the grid, the screen position and the aisles. Seat types and gaps are set afterwards on the seat map, which is non-destructive.
hall.regenerateWarnBody: Every existing seat is deleted and rebuilt, which resets the seat state of EVERY showtime in this hall back to available. Every seat id already issued for a showtime becomes invalid. The backend blocks this permanently once the hall has ever had a booking — including a cancelled one, on a showtime since deleted.
hall.splitCoupleConfirmBody: Splits this couple seat into 2 standard seats. Only refused if this seat has ever been part of a booking.
hall.templateHint: Pick a template and you do not need rows or seats per row.
hall.templateOverrides: With a template, the aisles, seat types, gaps and double seats all come from that template, not from this hall.
hall.title: Halls

concession.activeHint: Off hides it from the customer's combo step, but keeps the product here.
concession.deleteConfirm: Remove this product from the catalogue?
concession.deleteHint: Past orders stay readable: the record is hidden, not purged.
concession.imageUrlHint: This project hosts no concession artwork; leave it empty and the list shows no image.
concession.name: Product name
concession.priceHint: Whole VND. 0 means a giveaway, not an unset price.
concession.scopeHint: This list includes retired products; customers only ever see the ones on sale.
concession.title: Concessions

discount.activeHint: Off makes the code read as invalid to customers, but keeps it here.
discount.codeLocked: The code cannot change after creation: orders that already used it would be misread.
discount.deleteConfirm: Remove this code from the list?
discount.deleteHint: Orders that used it are untouched, and the code string becomes reusable.
discount.kindLocked: The type cannot change after creation, for the same reason.
discount.maxDiscountHint: Percentage codes only. Leave empty for no cap.
discount.minOrderHint: The ticket subtotal must reach this before the code applies. 0 = no minimum.
discount.realMoneyHint: These codes take real money off: the gateway charges the discounted amount.
discount.title: Discount codes
discount.windowHint: Leave empty for no time limit.

user.cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role. Ask another admin.
user.cannotLockSelf: You cannot lock your own account.
user.createScopeNote: Only staff and admin accounts can be created here. Customers register themselves.
user.guardsHint: Locking is reversible: the account can no longer sign in but keeps all of its data. The backend refuses three things: locking yourself, changing your own role, and demoting the last active admin.
user.passwordHint: 6 to 72 characters. The user changes it themselves after signing in.
user.searchPlaceholder: Search by email, name or phone
user.title: Users

report.axesHint: Revenue counts the day the customer PAID; occupancy counts the day the SHOWTIME ran. A ticket bought today for tomorrow's screening raises today's revenue and tomorrow's occupancy — the two numbers are not meant to agree.
report.emptyNoShowtimes: This range is closed but had no showtimes.
report.emptyNotClosed: No day in this range has been closed yet. The closeDay job runs at 23:59; it can also be triggered manually from the batch jobs screen.
report.missingDaysBody: These days have not been closed, so they have no figures yet: {{days}}. That is NOT zero revenue — the data is missing.
report.title: Reports
